East Brooklyn Bike Club Wednesday Ride

Brooklyn, NY · Brownsville · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

East Brooklyn Bike Club Wednesday Ride is a social group ride in Brooklyn, NY. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:00 pm from Citi Bike station at Zion Triangle. Pace: beginner pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @eastbrooklynbikeclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the East Brooklyn Bike Club Wednesday Ride group ride

A beginner ride through Brownsville and East Brooklyn, led by the East Brooklyn Bike Club. Part of Citi Bike's free Weekly Rides series, so you can use a Citi Bike at no charge. No sign-up. The posted schedule is from the 2025 season; check the club's Instagram for this year's dates.
